requiredFindings.title: Document quorums ignore the embedded revocation
requiredFindings.failureScenario: X4B r5 item 2 reverifies the catalog under TR-INDEX and each component manifest under TR-COMPONENT against the final root, with the embedded revocation's keys excluded, at the role quorum. A failure is PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE and writes nothing. The same item cites law 463 item 5's order, whose step 3 also requires the TR-CORE and TR-BUNDLE quorums still met after that key set. verify in crates/security/src/trust/trust_bootstrap.rs calls filter_envelope_revoked with an empty set. The list's keyIds re-filter only the index-0 root, each link, and the list. The catalog, component manifests, bootstrap manifest, and core inventory all share verify, so a revoked key still counts. quorum-roots.json schema 1 sets TR-INDEX threshold to 2, and INDEX_SIGNER signs with keys 11 and 12. a_revoked_document_is_present_then_revoke_with_revoked_by revokes key 11 and expects Present then Revoke and a durable ST-REVOKED index. After exclusion that quorum is one signature, so acceptance must refuse PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE (catalog) and leave P0 unchanged. Item 4's Revoke applies only when the quorum still meets after exclusion. Judgment call 3's unfiltered reading contradicts the r5 sentence. Required: exclude the list's keyIds inside verify. Retarget the two-signer TR-INDEX case to the refusal, and keep Present then Revoke for a quorum that survives exclusion.

scope: X4B-a r1 producer on daa7b01. RF-1: catalog, component, bundle, and inventory quorums must exclude the embedded list's keyIds. Judgment call 12: X4T r9 item 3 needs amending before a reader treats the chain's first root as accepted and heads.root as signing. Inventory v113 is ACCEPT on v114: 804 inherited rows equal by value, two rows added, 16 projection rows. verify_projection PASS with 83 corruptions refused. verify_scratch 78/72/16 with v113 selected. trust_bootstrap 16 passed.
